title: Signal: vcpkg dependency declared without a version floor
scope: A vcpkg.json file that declares a dependency named as a bare string, so its version comes from the baseline only.
limitations: It matches a dependency named as a bare string, so its version comes from the baseline only in the parsed vcpkg.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A vcpkg.json that mentions a dependency named as a bare string, so its version comes from the baseline only in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
